institution.title: Toronto Metropolitan University – (Formerly Ryerson University)
institution.description: The Archives serves as the institutional memory of the Toronto Metropolitan University community. The Archives appraises, preserves, and makes accessible a broad range of primary source materials which provide administrative, academic, fiscal, legal, social, and cultural record of Toronto Metropolitan University.

institution.title: Museum London
institution.description:
The Museum London collection page highlights a large and diverse archive of over 5,500 artworks and nearly 50,000 historical artifacts focused on the history and culture of London and Southwestern Ontario.
 
These links were provided by Zahra McDoom (TD Curator of Collections of Museum London)
